status: Draft source and design only. No new kernel evaluation, trajectory or training has been executed.
trainable_parameters: raw_theta1[9] and raw_theta2[9] only; all gains, inputs, references and targets frozen before evaluation
forward_links: link=FP32(x1), where x1=log(V1_repr/b1) from the original V3 asset feature map

gradient_modes.drive_only: Only conditioning link detached; its numerical forward value is unchanged
gradient_modes.conditioning_only: Only drive link detached; its numerical forward value is unchanged
gradient_modes.both_detached: Both interlayer routes detached; numerical forward values unchanged

mandatory_identification_checks: All four modes have equal finite forward state/readout/boundary values
Layer1 raw-parameter terminal VJP is nonzero in conditioning_only; zero is a retained failure, not a reason to retune
Layer1 full VJP equals drive_only plus conditioning_only within predeclared first-order tolerances
Layer1 raw VJP vanishes when both links are detached; layer2 raw VJP agrees across all four modes
Actual raw b2 varies within the 16-step rollout for at least one fixed sample
Four-state/18-parameter manual local-Jacobian composition matches actual terminal-loss BPTT
manual_chain_convention: G_l denotes continuous drift derivative, so ALL discrete cross-state and parameter blocks carry dt. A11/A22 are I+dt*local_state_J. A12=0.

manual_link_blocks.A21: dt*outer(K_drive+K_condition,[dx1/dz1,0]); dx1/dz1=1 in the underlying continuous formula

planned_inputs: Fixed mixed default/continuation physical points from the already observed 40-100 asset range; frozen deterministic drives and terminal z2/a2 targets. Functional fixtures, not unseen financial or quality samples.
loss_scope: Terminal z2/a2 only; no direct margin/boundary term and no layer1 loss. Loss improvement is not required.
precision_scope: CPU FP32 states and explicitly converted interlayer link; frozen FP64 financial arithmetic and saved 5x10 Jacobians; first-order VJP of continuous formulas at represented inputs, not rounding derivatives.
interpretation_limits: Each changing theta2(t) causes a new STATIC H-X feature evaluation. This is not the closed-form solution of a time-varying financial PDE or the coupled ODE.
Changing b2 within a trajectory and nonzero financial-route VJP demonstrate wiring, not regenerative spikes or task usefulness.
Detach modes are same-value derivative identification controls, not forward-model quality ablations.
Default saturation, tiny/negative training changes and all failed checks will be retained.
No new quality, multimodal, speed, GPU, power, stability or limit-cycle benchmark is opened.
